title: I_System_State_Vector
description: A comprehensive data structure representing the instantaneous state of the system. This vector captures the operational context, current system load metrics, a graph-based representation of traceability data, a registry of active entities, and the associated session security token. It is utilized for high-frequency telemetry, state synchronization, and audit trail generation.

activeContext.description: The current operational mode of the system execution environment. This dictates the logging verbosity, security constraints, and performance optimization strategies applied to the current session.

systemLoad.description: Real-time metrics regarding the computational and networking load of the host system processing the state vector.

cpuUsagePercentage.description: The aggregate CPU usage percentage across all available cores.

memoryUsageBytes.description: The total amount of RAM currently allocated to the process in bytes.

activeThreadCount.description: The number of active threads currently managed by the application runtime.

networkThroughputMbps.description: Current network throughput measured in Megabits per second.

ioWaitTimeMs.description: Average I/O wait time in milliseconds over the last sampling interval.

traceabilityGraph.description: A directed graph structure representing the flow of data and control between system components leading up to the current state. Used for root cause analysis and lineage tracking.

graphId.description: Unique identifier for this specific snapshot of the traceability graph.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the graph snapshot was finalized.

nodes.description: List of nodes in the traceability graph, representing system components or data entities.

type.description: The classification of the node within the system architecture.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata associated with the node state.

edges.description: List of directed edges representing interactions or data flow between nodes.

interactionType.description: Description of the interaction (e.g., RPC, SQL_QUERY, MESSAGE_PUBLISH).

latencyMs.description: Latency of the interaction in milliseconds.

registeredEntities.description: A registry of all entities (users, devices, or microservices) currently participating in the session or context scope.

status.description: Current connectivity or operational status of the entity.

lastSeen.description: Timestamp of the last verified activity from this entity.

permissions.description: List of permission scopes granted to this entity within the current state vector.

sessionToken.description: The cryptographic session token (e.g., JWT, Opaque Token) validating the authority to access or modify this system state.
